keywords: EF 协议 2026 优先事项改为扩容
改进 UX 与加固 L1 三条主线
EOA 原生密钥委托 EIP 提交
多 Agent AI 的隐私支付通道 PrivateX402
summary: EF 协议团队发布 2026 年优先事项：在扩容 L1、扩容 blob 与改进 UX 的基础上，重组为扩容、改进 UX 与加固 L1 三条主线。prestwich 提交 EOA 原生密钥委托 EIP，让 EIP-7702 委托支持非 ECDSA 密钥。Nethermind 研究员提出 PrivateX402，为多 Agent AI 系统提供隐私支付通道。

items.topic: 路线：EF 协议 2026 优先事项
items.title: EF 博客：2026 协议优先事项更新
items.note: （Protocol track leads）：2025 年 Pectra 上线 EIP-7702 让 EOA 可执行合约代码，实现批处理、gas 赞助与社交恢复，并使 blob 吞吐翻倍；2026 年设三条主线，扩容（Ansgar、Marius、Raúl）、改进 UX（Barnabé、Matt）与加固 L1（Fredrik、Pari、Thomas）。
items.title_en: EF blog: Protocol Priorities Update for 2026
items.note_en: (Protocol track leads): in 2025 Pectra shipped EIP-7702, letting EOAs run contract code for batching, gas sponsorship and social recovery, and doubled blob throughput; 2026 has three tracks, Scale (Ansgar, Marius, Raúl), Improve UX (Barnabé, Matt) and Harden the L1 (Fredrik, Pari, Thomas).

items.topic: 账户：EOA 原生密钥委托
items.title: 新增 EIP：EOA 原生密钥委托
items.note: （prestwich）提交：把 EIP-7702 委托扩展到非 ECDSA 密钥，新增同时支持原生密钥委托与签名的交易类型，首个类型为 ed25519。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Native Key Delegation for EOAs
items.note_en: (prestwich), submitted: extends EIP-7702 delegation to non ECDSA keys with a new transaction type for native key delegation and signing, starting with ed25519.

items.title: ethresear.ch：PrivateX402，多 Agent AI 系统的隐私支付通道
items.note: （Nethermind 的 Conor McMenamin 与 Artem Grigor）16:04：现有协议会暴露用户向哪些 Agent 付款及金额，泄露意图与行为模式，中心化中介能隐藏信息却带来单点风险。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: PrivateX402, privacy preserving payment channels for multi agent AI systems
items.note_en: (Conor McMenamin and Artem Grigor of Nethermind), 16:04: current protocols reveal which agents a user pays and how much, leaking intent and behavior, while a centralized facilitator can hide this but adds a single point of failure.

keywords_en: Improve UX and Harden the L1
Native Key Delegation for EOAs EIP submitted
PrivateX402 private payment channels for multi agent AI
summary_en: EF Protocol published its 2026 priorities, regrouping last year's Scale L1, Scale Blobs and Improve UX into three tracks: Scale, Improve UX and Harden the L1. prestwich submitted the Native Key Delegation for EOAs EIP, letting EIP-7702 delegation support non ECDSA keys. Nethermind researchers proposed PrivateX402, private payment channels for multi agent AI systems.
